# PrismJS

- Version: 1.30.0
- Source package: `prismjs@1.30.0` from the npm registry
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Included files: Prism Core, Markup and CSS components

The Editor uses Prism for HTML and CSS source shown in the existing code overlay. Its tokens use the same palette as TDS, defined by shared syntax color variables in `Edit/styles.css`. TDS continues to use the Editor's language-specific highlighter.

Upstream: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0
